lemmas.primary_translation: not want or be interested in talking to; have nothing unsettled or outstanding with; be on good terms with or reconciled with

definitions.text: ikke ha lyst til eller interesse av å snakke med
definitions.translation: not want, or have any interest in, talking to (someone)

examples.no: slike kjedelige typer hadde hun ikke noe usnakket med
examples.en: she had no desire to talk to such boring types

definitions.text: ikke ha noe uoppgjort eller utestående med
definitions.translation: not have anything unsettled or outstanding with (someone)
be on good terms with or reconciled with (someone)

examples.no: han har ikke noe usnakket med sin tidligere sjef
examples.en: he is on good terms with his former boss
